    {Y : Set ℝ} (hY : volume Yᶜ = 0)

theorem exists_isolating_interval {μ : Measure ℝ} (hfin : ∀ a b : ℝ, μ (Ioo a b) ≠ ∞)
    {Y : Set ℝ} (hY : volume Yᶜ = 0)
    (hcount : ∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y, a < b → ∃ k : ℕ, μ (Ioc a b) = k) (x : ℝ) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, a < x ∧ x < b ∧ μ (Ioo a b \ {x}) = 0 ∧ ∃ k : ℕ, μ {x} = k
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  set s : ℕ → Set ℝ := fun n => Ioo (x - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) (x + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) with hs
  have htend : Tendsto (fun n => μ (s n)) atTop (𝓝 (μ {x})) := by
    have h := tendsto_measure_iInter_atTop (μ := μ) (s := s)
      (fun n => measurableSet_Ioo.nullMeasurableSet) (antitone_Ioo_shrink x) ⟨0, hfin _ _⟩
    rwa [show ⋂ n, s n = {x} from iInter_Ioo_shrink x] at h
  have hx_mem : ∀ n, x ∈ s n := fun n => by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    simp only [hs, mem_Ioo]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hxfin : μ {x} ≠ ∞ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (hfin _ _) (measure_mono (singleton_subset_iff.mpr (hx_mem 0)))
  -- an integer point mass in every shrinking interval
  have hpick : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : ℝ, ∃ k : ℕ, x - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) < a ∧ a < x ∧ x < b ∧
      b < x + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ∧ μ (Ioc a b) = k := by
    intro n
    have hε : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨a, haY, ha1, ha2⟩ := exists_mem_Ioo_of_compl_null hY (show x - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) < x by
      linarith)
    obtain ⟨b, hbY, hb1, hb2⟩ := exists_mem_Ioo_of_compl_null hY (show x < x + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) by
      linarith)
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hcount a haY b hbY (by linarith)
    exact ⟨a, b, k, ha1, ha2, hb1, hb2, hk⟩
  choose A B K hA1 hA2 hB1 hB2 hK using hpick
  have hIoc_sub : ∀ n, Ioc (A n) (B n) ⊆ s n := fun n y hy => by
    simp only [hs, mem_Ioo]; exact ⟨by linarith [hy.1, hA1 n], by linarith [hy.2, hB2 n]⟩
  have hx_Ioc : ∀ n, x ∈ Ioc (A n) (B n) := fun n => ⟨hA2 n, (hB1 n).le⟩
  have hlow : ∀ n, μ {x} ≤ K n := fun n => by
    rw [← hK n]; exact measure_mono (singleton_subset_iff.mpr (hx_Ioc n))
  have hup : ∀ n, (K n : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ μ (s n) := fun n => by
    rw [← hK n]; exact measure_mono (hIoc_sub n)
  -- eventually the shrinking masses are below `μ{x} + 1/2`
  have hlt : μ {x} < μ {x} + (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) := ENNReal.lt_add_right hxfin (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (htend.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hlt))
  set m := (μ {x}).toReal with hm
  have hK_real : ∀ n, N ≤ n → m ≤ K n ∧ (K n : ℝ) < m + 1 / 2 := by
    intro n hn
    have h1 := hlow n
    have h2 : (K n : ℝ≥0∞) < μ {x} + 1 / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (hup n) (hN n hn)
    have hfin' : μ {x} + (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞ := ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨hxfin, by norm_num⟩
    constructor
    · have := ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _) h1
      simpa [hm] using this
    · have := (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _) hfin').mpr h2
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_add hxfin (by norm_num)] at this
      simpa [hm] using this
  have hconst : ∀ n, N ≤ n → K n = K N := fun n hn =>
    nat_eq_of_mem_half_interval (hK_real n hn).1 (hK_real n hn).2 (hK_real N le_rfl).1
      (hK_real N le_rfl).2
  -- the integer value equals the point mass
  have hKle : (K N : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ μ {x} := by
    refine ge_of_tendsto' htend fun n => ?_
    rcases le_total N n with hn | hn
    · rw [← hconst n hn]; exact hup n
    · exact (hup N).trans (measure_mono (antitone_Ioo_shrink x hn))
  have hxK : μ {x} = K N := le_antisymm (hlow N) hKle
  refine ⟨A N, B N, hA2 N, hB1 N, ?_, K N, hxK⟩
  have hIocfin : μ (Ioc (A N) (B N)) ≠ ∞ := by rw [hK N]; exact ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _
  have hdiff : μ (Ioc (A N) (B N) \ {x}) = 0 := by
    rw [measure_sdiff (singleton_subset_iff.mpr (hx_Ioc N)) (measurableSet_singleton x).nullMeasurableSet
      hxfin, hK N, hxK, tsub_self]
  exact measure_mono_null (sdiff_subset_sdiff_left Ioo_subset_Ioc_self) hdiff

  classical
  by_cases hr : (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis
  · exact Or.inl hr
  right
  have hn : ¬ (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ T₀ : ℝ, ∀ T, T₀ ≤ T →
      ∫ τ in Ioc T (2 * T), ‖w (-τ) - c₀⁻¹‖ * ‖phiG G τ‖ ≤ η * T) :=
    fun h => hr (lock_rigidity_of_block_means hW hGc hGd hG2 hwm hwb hc₀ hY hlock h)
  push Not at hn
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hlarge⟩ := hn
  obtain ⟨K, TK, hK, hphi⟩ := exists_norm_phiG_le_littlewood hW hGc hGd hG2
  refine ⟨η * Real.exp (-4), K, mul_pos hη (Real.exp_pos _), hK, fun R => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hbad⟩ := hlarge (max R TK)
  have hTR : R ≤ T := (le_max_left _ _).trans hT
  have hTK : TK ≤ T := (le_max_right _ _).trans hT
  refine ⟨T, hTR, ?_⟩
  set u : ℝ → ℂ := fun τ => w (-τ) - c₀⁻¹
  have hum : Measurable u := (hwm.comp measurable_neg).sub_const _
  have hub : ∀ τ, ‖u τ‖ ≤ Cw + ‖c₀⁻¹‖ := fun τ =>
    (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith [hwb (-τ)])
  have huI : IntegrableOn (fun τ => ‖u τ‖) (Ioc T (2 * T)) := by
    refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := Cw + ‖c₀⁻¹‖)
      (by simp [Real.volume_Ioc]) hum.norm.aestronglyMeasurable (Eventually.of_forall fun τ => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
    exact hub τ
  set q : ℝ := K * Real.log T / Real.log (Real.log T)
  have hpt : ∀ τ ∈ Ioc T (2 * T), ‖u τ‖ * ‖phiG G τ‖ ≤
      (Real.exp 4 * Real.exp q) * ‖u τ‖ := fun τ hτ => by
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hphi T hTK τ hτ) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hmono := setIntegral_mono_on (integrableOn_mul_norm_phiG hGc hum hub T)
    (huI.const_mul (Real.exp 4 * Real.exp q)) measurableSet_Ioc hpt
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hmono
  have hbad' : η * T ≤ (Real.exp 4 * Real.exp q) * ∫ τ in Ioc T (2 * T), ‖u τ‖ :=
    hbad.le.trans hmono
  have hcancel : Real.exp (-4) * Real.exp (-q) * (Real.exp 4 * Real.exp q) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
    convert Real.exp_zero using 1; ring
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbad' (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos (-4)) (Real.exp_pos (-q))).le
  calc (η * Real.exp (-4)) * T * Real.exp (-q)
      = (Real.exp (-4) * Real.exp (-q)) * (η * T) := by ring
    _ ≤ (Real.exp (-4) * Real.exp (-q)) *
        ((Real.exp 4 * Real.exp q) * ∫ τ in Ioc T (2 * T), ‖u τ‖) := h
    _ = ∫ τ in Ioc T (2 * T), ‖u τ‖ := by rw [← mul_assoc, hcancel, one_mul]

  have hQd := differentiable_atomQ hone hsum
  have hQne : ∀ z ∈ V, atomQ m t z ≠ 0 := fun z hz =>
    atomQ_ne_zero hone hsum (ne_atomAt_of_re_ne (by
      have : (1 : ℝ) < z.re := hz; intro h; rw [h] at this; norm_num at this))
  set r : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => bigG lam z ^ k / atomQ m t z with hr
  have hGk : ∀ z : ℂ, 1 < z.re → HasDerivAt (fun w => bigG lam w ^ k)
      ((k : ℂ) * bigG lam z ^ (k - 1) * (bigG lam z * (1 / z + 1 / (z - 1) +
        gammaRealLogConnection z - LSeries (lamTwo lam) z))) z := by
    intro z hz
    have h := (hasDerivAt_bigG hsl hz).pow k
    refine HasDerivAt.congr_deriv (f := fun w => bigG lam w ^ k) h ?_
    ring
  have hrd : DifferentiableOn ℂ r V := fun z hz =>
    ((hGk z hz).differentiableAt.div (hQd z) (hQne z hz)).differentiableWithinAt
  have hderiv : Set.EqOn (deriv r) 0 V := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : 1 < z.re := hz
    have hz1 : ∀ i : AtomIndex m, z ≠ atomAt t i := ne_atomAt_of_re_ne (by
      intro h; rw [h] at hz'; norm_num at hz')

    rw [logDeriv_apply] at hL

      rw [← hL]; field_simp [hQne z hz]
    have hd : HasDerivAt r (((k : ℂ) * bigG lam z ^ (k - 1) * (bigG lam z * (1 / z + 1 / (z - 1) +
        gammaRealLogConnection z - LSeries (lamTwo lam) z)) * atomQ m t z -
          bigG lam z ^ k * deriv (atomQ m t) z) / atomQ m t z ^ 2) z :=
      (hGk z hz').div (hQd z).hasDerivAt (hQne z hz)
    have hze : 1 / z + 1 / (z - 1) + gammaRealLogConnection z - LSeries (lamTwo lam) z =
        atomicPairSeries (fun j => Real.pi * m j / k) t z := by
      rw [← hid z hz']
      unfold zetaArchimedeanDatum gammaRealLogConnection
      ring
    have hpow : (k : ℂ) * bigG lam z ^ (k - 1) * bigG lam z = (k : ℂ) * bigG lam z ^ k := by
      obtain ⟨k', rfl⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
      simp [pow_succ]

    simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
    rw [div_eq_zero_iff]

            atomQ m t z := by ring

/-! ## The main theorem -/

/-- **A `1/k`-integer counting function makes the producer a real-rooted twin.**  Let `lam` be
full-cone Weil-positive and `k ≥ 1`.  Suppose `k · μ_lam((a,b]) ∈ ℕ` for all `a < b` in a set of
full Lebesgue measure, and `μ_lam` has no mass on `(−1, 1)`.  Then there are integers `m_j` and
ordinates `t_j ≥ 1` with `Σ m_j/t_j² < ∞` such that `G^k = K·Q` on `Re s > 1`, where
`G(s) = s(s−1)Γ_ℝ(s) exp(Σ lam(n) n^{−s}/log n)` and `Q = atomQ m t` is entire, symmetric under
`s ↦ 1 − s`, and vanishes only on the critical line. -/

    have hsub : (T : Set ℝ) ⊆ I₁ := fun x hx => (hTsub hx).1

# The integer atomic floor of the canonical Weil measure

The floor of every actual singleton mass defines a dominated integer-valued atomic submeasure.
Its complement is a positive measure with every atom below one. Exact subtraction is proved on
finite-mass measurable sets by restricting before invoking finite measure cancellation. No
atomicity, discreteness, or total-mass assumption on the canonical source is supplied.

/-- Integer part of the actual canonical singleton mass. -/
def quantizationIntegerWeight {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (r : ℝ) : ℕ :=
  ⌊(boundaryMeasure hW).real {r}⌋₊

/-- The canonical integer atomic floor, with no atomicity assumption on the source. -/
def quantizationIntegerMeasure {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) : Measure ℝ :=
  Measure.sum fun r : ℝ => (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ≥0∞) • Measure.dirac r

/-- Positive residual measure after removal of the actual integer atomic floor. -/
def quantizationResidualMeasure {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) : Measure ℝ :=
  boundaryMeasure hW - quantizationIntegerMeasure hW

theorem quantizationIntegerWeight_le {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (r : ℝ) :
    (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ boundaryMeasure hW {r} := by
  calc
    (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ≥0∞) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ) := by simp
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((boundaryMeasure hW).real {r}) :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (Nat.floor_le ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
    _ ≤ boundaryMeasure hW {r} := ENNReal.ofReal_toReal_le

theorem quantizationIntegerMeasure_apply {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : Set ℝ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    quantizationIntegerMeasure hW s =
      ∑' r : ℝ, ((s.indicator (quantizationIntegerWeight hW) r : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) := by
  classical
  rw [quantizationIntegerMeasure, Measure.sum_apply _ hs]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro r
  by_cases hr : r ∈ s <;> simp [Measure.smul_apply, hr]

theorem quantizationIntegerMeasure_le {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) :
    quantizationIntegerMeasure hW ≤ boundaryMeasure hW := by
  classical
  refine Measure.le_iff.mpr fun s hs => ?_
  rw [quantizationIntegerMeasure_apply hW hs, ENNReal.tsum_eq_iSup_sum]
  refine iSup_le fun F => ?_
  calc
    ∑ r ∈ F, ((s.indicator (quantizationIntegerWeight hW) r : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤
        ∑ r ∈ F, (boundaryMeasure hW).restrict s {r} := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro r _
      by_cases hr : r ∈ s
      · simpa [Measure.restrict_apply (measurableSet_singleton r),
          singleton_inter_of_mem hr, hr] using quantizationIntegerWeight_le hW r
      · simp [hr, Measure.restrict_apply (measurableSet_singleton r),
          singleton_inter_of_notMem hr]
    _ = (boundaryMeasure hW).restrict s (F : Set ℝ) := sum_measure_singleton
    _ ≤ (boundaryMeasure hW).restrict s univ := measure_mono (subset_univ _)
    _ = boundaryMeasure hW s := by simp

theorem quantizationIntegerMeasure_singleton {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (r : ℝ) :
    quantizationIntegerMeasure hW {r} = (quantizationIntegerWeight hW r : ℝ≥0∞) :=

theorem quantizationIntegerMeasure_nat {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)

  · simp
  · intro r hr
    have hz : f r = 0 := by simpa using hr
    simp [hz]

# The boundary measure of an atomic Weil function

If the Weil function of a full-cone Weil-positive `lam` is, on `Re s > 1`, the positive atomic
Herglotz series `Σ_i c_i (1/(s − ½ − iτ_i) + 1/(s − ½ + iτ_i))`, then its boundary measure is the
atomic measure

`μ_lam = Σ_i c_i (δ_{τ_i} + δ_{−τ_i})`  (`boundaryMeasure_eq_atomicMeasure`).

**Proof.**  For a test `f`, the explicit formula applied to the translates of `f ⋆ f̃`
(`hasSum_spectralKernel_atomic`) shows that `|f̂|² Σ_i c_i (δ_{τ_i} + δ_{−τ_i})` has the spectral
kernel of `f` as characteristic function, so it is the Bochner measure of `f`, which is
`|f̂|² μ_lam` (`WeilSpectral.eq_withDensity_boundaryMeasure`).  On the shells where the mollifier
transforms are bounded below the densities can be divided out (`eq_of_forall_withDensity_mollC`).
-/

/-! ## Measures determined by their mollified versions -/

/-- Two measures with the same `|ρ̂_j|²`-weighted versions for every mollifier coincide. -/
theorem eq_of_forall_withDensity_mollC {μ₁ μ₂ : Measure ℝ}
    (h : ∀ j : ℕ, μ₁.withDensity (fun r => (specDensity (WeilHerglotz.mollC j) r : ℝ≥0∞)) =
      μ₂.withDensity (fun r => (specDensity (WeilHerglotz.mollC j) r : ℝ≥0∞))) : μ₁ = μ₂ := by
  have hpiece : ∀ (μ : Measure ℝ) (j : ℕ), μ.restrict (shell j) =
      ((μ.withDensity fun r => (specDensity (WeilHerglotz.mollC j) r : ℝ≥0∞)).restrict
        (shell j)).withDensity fun r => (invDensity j r : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    intro μ j
    have hmχ := measurable_specDensity (WeilHerglotz.integrable_mollC j)
    have hmi := measurable_invDensity j
    have hone : (fun r => (specDensity (WeilHerglotz.mollC j) r : ℝ≥0∞)) *
        (fun r => (invDensity j r : ℝ≥0∞)) =ᵐ[μ.restrict (shell j)] 1 := by
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, ae_restrict_iff' (measurableSet_shell j)]
      refine Eventually.of_forall fun r hr => ?_
      have hpos := specDensity_mollC_pos j hr
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.one_apply, invDensity]
      rw [← ENNReal.coe_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hpos.ne', ENNReal.coe_one]
    rw [restrict_withDensity (measurableSet_shell j), ← withDensity_mul _ hmχ.coe_nnreal_ennreal
      hmi.coe_nnreal_ennreal, withDensity_congr_ae hone, withDensity_one]
  rw [← Measure.restrict_univ (μ := μ₁), ← Measure.restrict_univ (μ := μ₂), ← iUnion_shell,
    Measure.restrict_iUnion shell_pairwise_disjoint measurableSet_shell,
    Measure.restrict_iUnion shell_pairwise_disjoint measurableSet_shell]
  congr 1
  funext j
  rw [hpiece μ₁ j, hpiece μ₂ j, h j]

/-! ## The explicit formula on translated autocorrelations -/

theorem contDiff_transl {k : ℝ → ℂ} (hk : ContDiff ℝ 2 k) (y : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (transl y k) :=
  hk.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)

theorem hasCompactSupport_transl {k : ℝ → ℂ} (hkc : HasCompactSupport k) (y : ℝ) :
    HasCompactSupport (transl y k) :=
  hkc.comp_homeomorph (Homeomorph.subRight y)

/-- Translating multiplies the transform by `e^{(s − ½) y}`, bounded on the strip. -/
theorem norm_Hfn_transl_weilTest_le {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hfc : HasCompactSupport f)
    (y : ℝ) : ∃ D : ℝ, ∀ σ t : ℝ, -1 ≤ σ → σ ≤ 2 →
      ‖Hfn (transl y (EF.weilTest f f)) (σ + t * I)‖ ≤ D / (1 + t ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨D, hD0, hD⟩ := norm_Hfn_weilTest_le hf hfc
  refine ⟨Real.exp (3 / 2 * |y|) * D, fun σ t h1 h2 => ?_⟩
  have hfac : Hfn (transl y (EF.weilTest f f)) (σ + t * I) =
      cexp (((σ : ℂ) + t * I - 1 / 2) * y) * Hfn (EF.weilTest f f) (σ + t * I) := by
    unfold Hfn
    rw [paperFT_transl]
    congr 2
    field_simp
  rw [hfac, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp, mul_div_assoc]
  refine mul_le_mul ?_ (hD σ t h1 h2) (norm_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  rw [Real.exp_le_exp]
  have hre : (((σ : ℂ) + t * I - 1 / 2) * y).re = (σ - 1 / 2) * y := by simp
  rw [hre]
  calc (σ - 1 / 2) * y ≤ |σ - 1 / 2| * |y| := by
        rw [← abs_mul]; exact le_abs_self _
    _ ≤ 3 / 2 * |y| := by
        gcongr
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor <;> linarith

/-- **The explicit formula for the spectral kernel of an atomic Weil function.** -/
theorem hasSum_spectralKernel_atomic {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hsl : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 < σ → Summable fun n : ℕ => |lam n| / (n : ℝ) ^ σ)
    {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] {c τ : ι → ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, 0 ≤ c i)
    (hΦ : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re →
      HasSum (fun i => (c i : ℂ) * gPair (1 / 2 + τ i * I) s) (WeilHerglotz.weilFunction lam s))
    {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hfc : HasCompactSupport f) (y : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun i => (c i : ℂ) *
        (cexp (y * τ i * I) * ((‖paperFT f (τ i)‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) +
          cexp (y * (-τ i) * I) * ((‖paperFT f (-τ i)‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      (spectralKernel lam f y) := by

/-!
# Weil-positive systems with near-integer atomic spectrum

Let `lam` be full-cone Weil-positive whose boundary measure `μ_lam` is purely atomic:
`μ_lam = Σ_j c_j (δ_{t_j} + δ_{−t_j})` with distinct ordinates `t_j ≥ 1`, `t_j → ∞`, and real
masses `c_j ≥ 0` (in the sense of the Poisson representation of the Weil function).

**Theorem** (`vonMangoldt_and_riemannHypothesis_of_near_integer_atoms`).  If the masses are integers
up to a total deviation of power growth less than one,

`Σ_{t_j < y} |c_j − round(c_j)| = O(y^α)`,  `α < 1`,

then `lam(n) = Λ(n)` for every `n ≥ 2`, and the Riemann hypothesis holds.

This is stated in the Weil-cone language and needs no producer: no continuity of boundary values,
no growth premise.  With `c_j ∈ ℕ` it is the atomic case of integer-counting rigidity
(`vonMangoldt_and_riemannHypothesis_of_integer_counting`).  The masses may deviate from integers
at infinitely many ordinates, with infinite total deviation.

**Proof.**  The Poisson representation turns the Weil function into the atomic Herglotz series
with real masses (`weilFunction_eq_atomicPairSeries`).  Every Weil-positive system has
absolutely convergent Dirichlet series on `Re s > 1`
(`WeilMeanSquare.summable_abs_div_rpow_of_weilPositiveFull`).  The two-sided fractional-mass
rigidity theorem (`AbelianTwist.fractional_two_sided_power_growth_rigidity`) then applies, with no
integer part.
-/

open Complex MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
open scoped ComplexConjugate ENNReal

namespace RHTower.WeilSpectral

open WeilHerglotz IntegerMassRigidity AbelianTwist FractionalMassRigidity FractionalMassTailRigidity

/-- The atomic Herglotz series with masses `π c_j` is the real-mass series `Σ c_j 2w/(w² + t_j²)`,

theorem atomicPairSeries_pi_mul_eq (c t : ℕ → ℝ) (s : ℂ) :
    atomicPairSeries (fun j => Real.pi * c j) t s =
      ∑' k, (c k : ℂ) * (2 * (s - 1 / 2) / ((s - 1 / 2) ^ 2 + (t k : ℂ) ^ 2)) := by
  unfold atomicPairSeries
  rw [← tsum_mul_left]
  congr 1
  funext k
  have hπ : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero
  push_cast
  field_simp

theorem atomicPairSeries_zero (t : ℕ → ℝ) (s : ℂ) :
    atomicPairSeries (fun _ => Real.pi * ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ)) t s = 0 := by
  unfold atomicPairSeries
  simp

/-- **Near-integer atomic spectra force `Λ` and RH.**  A full-cone Weil-positive system whose
boundary measure is `Σ_j c_j(δ_{t_j} + δ_{−t_j})`, with distinct `t_j ≥ 1`, `t_j → ∞`, `c_j ≥ 0`,
and `Σ_{t_j < y}|c_j − round(c_j)| ≤ K y^α` for some `α < 1`, is `Λ`, and RH holds. -/
theorem vonMangoldt_and_riemannHypothesis_of_near_integer_atoms {lam : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) {c t : ℕ → ℝ} (hc : ∀ j, 0 ≤ c j) (hone : ∀ j, 1 ≤ t j)
    (hinj : Function.Injective t) (htt : Tendsto t atTop atTop)
    (hsum : Summable fun j => c j / t j ^ 2)
    (hrep : ∀ w : ℂ, 0 < w.re → ∫⁻ r, poissonDensity w r ∂boundaryMeasure hW =
      ∑' j, ENNReal.ofReal (c j) * (poissonDensity w (t j) + poissonDensity w (-(t j))))
    (hgrowth : ∃ α K : ℝ, α < 1 ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y →
      phaseSum (fun j => |c j - round (c j)|) t y ≤ K * y ^ α) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis := by
  have hid0 := weilFunction_eq_atomicPairSeries hW hc hone hsum hrep
  have hfun : (fun n => if 2 ≤ n then (lam n : ℂ) else 0) = lamC lam := by
    funext n
    rw [lamC]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hid : ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → zetaArchimedeanDatum s + 1 / (s - 1) -
      LSeries (fun n => if 2 ≤ n then (lam n : ℂ) else 0) s =
        atomicPairSeries (fun j => Real.pi * ((fun _ => 0 : ℕ → ℕ) j : ℝ)) t s +
          ∑' k, (c k : ℂ) * (2 * (s - 1 / 2) / ((s - 1 / 2) ^ 2 + (t k : ℂ) ^ 2)) := by
    intro s hs
    rw [atomicPairSeries_zero, zero_add, ← atomicPairSeries_pi_mul_eq, ← hid0 s hs, weilFunction,
      zetaArchimedeanDatum, hfun]
